name: 74HC595 8-Bit Shift Register IC
description: Serial-in, parallel-out 8-stage shift register with storage latch that expands 3 microcontroller pins into 8 independent digital outputs.
realWorldAnalogy: Serial-in, parallel-out 8-stage shift register with storage latch that expands 3 microcontroller pins into 8 independent digital outputs.

pinout.description: Output Enable (active LOW - tie to GND)

wiringGuidance: Connect DS to Pin 11, ST_CP (latch) to Pin 8, SH_CP (clock) to Pin 12. Tie OE to GND and MR to 5V.
commonMistakes: Leaving OE (Output Enable) floating high, which turns off all outputs.
Leaving MR (Master Reset) low or disconnected, which keeps the register cleared.

miniExperiment.title: 8-LED Shift Chaser
miniExperiment.circuit: Connect DS to Pin 11, Latch to Pin 8, Clock to Pin 12. Connect Q0-Q7 through 220-ohm resistors to 8 LEDs.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: A single lit LED sweeps across the 8 output pins in sequence.
